intro.text: A scout working under Tyn in Macob's caravan as it crosses the Frostlands.

items.text: After the caravan fled a band of raiders, Yix and Tyn caught Shallan and Tvlakv spying on their camp.

appearance.text: He has golden hair, wears tan clothing and carries a sword.

personality.text: Highly suspicious and good at moving quietly.
